validity.researcher_notes: Status=operating with no StartYear1 was a genuine gap. Two independent sources agree the receiving complex at the Amreya end of this pipeline (Western Desert Gas Complex / WDGC) was commissioned in 2000: Oil & Gas Journal states 'Commissioned in 2000, WDGC — which receives and treats Western Desert gases from Badr El-Din Petroleum Co.'s Al-Obayed and Khalda Petroleum Co.'s Salam, Tarek, and El-Qaser fields'; GASCO's own site/company profile independently states the complex's 'actual operation... began in March 2000' (foundation stone laid December 1997) and, on its separate gas-plants page, that 'operation began in May 2000' (month differs slightly across GASCO's own two documents — flagging that minor internal inconsistency rather than picking one arbitrarily, hence year only, no month staged). Since WDGC cannot process gas without this feeder pipeline already delivering it, 2000 is the best-evidenced start year for the pipeline itself; I did not find a source dating the pipeline's own commissioning as distinct from the complex's. Separately, one SPE/academic paper (via ResearchGate/OnePetro, both blocked to fetch — HTTP 403, no Wayback snapshot, so NOT used as a citable ref) describes the Obaiyed field's gathering system, gas plant and 'export pipelines' coming onstream in 1999 — a plausible earlier bound, but since I could not verify a working, citable URL for that claim, I am not staging 1999 and am relying on the two sources I could verify.

fills.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2000 reflects when the Amreya-end Western Desert Gas Complex (WDGC) — which this pipeline feeds and cannot operate without — was commissioned, corroborated by an independent trade-press source (Oil & Gas Journal) and the operator's own site (GASCO). StartMonth1 intentionally left blank: GASCO's own gas-plants page says May 2000 while its 2024 WDGC company-profile PDF says March 2000 — an internal inconsistency I am not resolving by picking one. Not staging 1999 (the Obaiyed field's own onstream year per an SPE/academic paper) because I could not obtain a working, verifiable URL for that source (ResearchGate and OnePetro both returned HTTP 403 with no Wayback snapshot) — per standing rule 2/3, no fabricated or unverifiable-URL citation goes in the workbook.
